items.prompt:
Which sentence is an opinion?
A) The sky is blue.
B) I think the sky is the prettiest color.
items.answer: B) I think the sky is the prettiest color.

steps: 'I think' and 'prettiest' show an opinion. Key is B.
solution.answer: B) I think the sky is the prettiest color.
